description.en: Generates landing-page copy and renders it as a Next.js (marketing) route group inside the generated app. Requires a SaaS factory in the project (directory saas-factory/ or FACTORY_ROOT with the CLI tools/factory); it is not part of this repository.
description.de: Generiert Landing-Page-Copy und rendert sie als Next.js (marketing) Routen-Gruppe in der generierten App. Voraussetzung: eine SaaS-Factory im Projekt (Verzeichnis saas-factory/ oder FACTORY_ROOT mit der CLI tools/factory); sie gehört nicht zu diesem Repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions:
Creates a marketing landing page for the generated app. Take the tone and target audience from the spec. Avoid AI tells (no 'unleash', 'leverage', 'seamless').
The working directory for this run is {{ execution_path }}. Use only this run workspace for builds and code changes. {{ project_path }} only identifies the original project. No automatic merge or push; keep the results for separate adoption.

config.success_criteria: src/app/(marketing)/page.tsx exists in the project directory and contains the hero/features/CTA from the copy. `npm run build` succeeds.
config.goal:
Take the following landing-page copy and render it as the Next.js route group `(marketing)` in project {{ slug }}.

PROJECT PATH: ${FACTORY_ROOT:-./saas-factory}/{{ slug }}

LANDING COPY (JSON):
{{ previous_output }}

TASK:
1. Create src/app/(marketing)/page.tsx with:
   - Hero (headline + subheadline) — h1, lead paragraph
   - 3-5 feature blocks as a grid
   - CTA button (primary + micro line)
   - Meta tags via the Next.js metadata export
2. Use Tailwind classes that subtly integrate the brand_primary_color {{ brand_primary_color }} (e.g. as an accent in buttons).
3. If not present yet: src/app/(marketing)/layout.tsx with a minimal footer.
4. Break nothing in the main app area — the / route stays as it is.
5. At the end: run `npm run build` and fix the errors.

Do not embed external images (put the OG image prompt only as a comment in the metadata config).
